claim_scope: Post hoc, label-free PyMBAR analysis of the frozen short force-consistent multi-MLIP OBC-II/ACE lambda diagnostic. This exposes the upstream estimator and overlap evidence but cannot establish equilibrium, conformer mixing, chemical accuracy, confirmation, or product certification.

analysis.standard_state: gas 1 M to ideal-dilute solution 1 M

dependency.name: pymbar
dependency.role: Upstream MBAR estimator, equilibration detection, statistical inefficiency, decorrelation, effective sample counts, and overlap matrix.

decision_policy.reason: The parent windows are only 30 fs and were frozen before an equilibrium or conformer-mixing claim. Passing post hoc overlap cannot repair that missing sampling evidence.

limitations: Every source record is development-only and contains only 40 production frames per window after a fixed 10 fs discard.
Automatic time-series diagnostics cannot prove mixing on timescales longer than the recorded trajectories.
Experimental FreeSolv labels are neither required nor opened by this analysis.
This analysis can validate estimator plumbing and expose overlap; it cannot promote the parent short TI screen.

literature.citation: Shirts MR, Chodera JD. J Chem Phys 129, 124105 (2008).
Chodera JD. J Chem Theory Comput 12, 1799-1805 (2016).
